bucket_note: bucket k holds latencies in [2^k - 1, 2^(k+1) - 2] ns; non-negative values only

provenance.clock_source: unknown and not recorded in the file: whether the stamp is hardware (NIC) or kernel software, and whether the host was NTP- or PTP-disciplined, is not stated by IEX
provenance.offset_limits: the host clock's offset to IEX's send clock is unknown, so receive - send contains an unidentified constant offset (and the 37 s TAI/UTC leap-second question for the capture host, already removed from the ingested send times); only DIFFERENCES within one capture (jitter, spikes, ordering) are interpretable; the ABSOLUTE feed latency, and the skew against a Nasdaq stamp from another host, are not identified
provenance.resolution: pcapng: the interface's if_tsresol (microsecond or nanosecond, read from the file); classic pcap: by magic number; a pcapng SIMPLE packet block carries no timestamp (then receive_ts is None and counted in capture_ts_missing)
provenance.use: report feed latency and cross-venue skew with these qualifications; never as a trading advantage or a measured order-entry latency
provenance.what: the capture host's packet timestamp (pcapng enhanced packet block / pcap record); kept per IEX-TP segment as IexReader.receive_ts, session-relative nanoseconds
